text.name: Sacrifice
text.description:
{Spell Scroll}

This scroll contains the Sacrifice spell which is added into your spell book for as long as you carry the scroll.
text.event: On your way you stumble upon a small patch of terrain covered in flames. In the middle of this place you see a wand, clearly emanating a magical power, stuck in the ground. You decide to grab the wand from the fire and keep it for yourself.
